rule: PLANNER.md section 2: a syllabus bullet that lists members becomes a container plus one objective per member. A list is split only when each member is something a learner must separately know or do, with its own answer. A list that qualifies one skill (the prefixes a learner converts between, the stages of one mechanism, the terms an explanation must use) is left whole. Member wording is ours, built only from the bullet's own words; the bullet itself stays verbatim on the container.
replaces: the regex splitter in decompose_objectives.py up to 2026-10-17, which produced non-objectives such as 'explain deci', 'state lakes' and 'identify on drawings'

kept_whole_on_purpose.1.2.4 explain and use sub-multiple prefi: the prefixes are the material of one conversion skill, not separate skills
kept_whole_on_purpose.3.5 explain enzyme action: active site, complex, substrate and product are the terms one explanation must use
kept_whole_on_purpose.3.7 explain the mechanisms by which wate: one continuous pathway; split, each stage loses its cause
kept_whole_on_purpose.3.9 list the features of gas exchange su: the objective is to list them together; each feature's reason is taught in the notes
kept_whole_on_purpose.4.1 state the role of mitosis: one list recalled as a set
kept_whole_on_purpose.5.1 identify producers, primary ... cons: one skill applied across a chain, web or pyramid
